subject: Berklee Institute of Jazz and Gender Justice
overview: The Medford Jazz Festival concluded its final day with performances by the Berklee Institute of Jazz for Gender Justice and vocalist Donna McElroy. The event highlighted works by women and non-binary composers alongside jazz standards and community heritage at the West Medford Community Center.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Sponsor Acknowledgments
items.summary: Producer Jonathan Fagan opened the final day of the festival, thanking local sponsors including the Medford Arts Council and the West Medford Community Center.

items.title: Berklee Institute of Jazz for Gender Justice Performance
items.summary: Terry Carter introduced the Berklee Institute of Jazz for Gender Justice, led by drummer Ivana Cuesta, which performed a set exclusively featuring works by women and non-binary composers. Ivana Cuesta discussed the ensemble's mission to address underrepresentation in the music industry before performing her original composition Chaos and works by Caroline Davis and Diane Stevens.

items.title: Donna McElroy Ensemble Performance
items.summary: Donna McElroy and her ensemble performed a set of original works and jazz standards, including a composition written in response to the Rodney King era. The performance featured George W. Russell Jr., Sean Farias, and Sean Skeet, concluding with an acapella encore of Misty.

items.title: Closing Acknowledgments
items.summary: Organizers provided final acknowledgments to the staff, volunteers, and Medford Community Media for their role in producing and broadcasting the three-day festival.
